items.title: Agent entity, Ticket assignee relation and stored due time, SLA target constants, migration, ApiTestCase
POST /api/agents (create, unique email) and GET /api/agents (list, active first)
PATCH /api/agents/{id} to change the active flag
PATCH /api/tickets/{id}/assignee: assign, unassign, assignee object in all ticket JSON
GET /api/tickets?breached=true|false filter, combinable with status filter
GET /api/reports/sla per-priority totals, breached counts and breach rate
URS-N acceptance sweep: audit log entries, JSON errors with no 500, backward compatibility, traffic replay

notes: U4: no status filter exists yet (open request 001); build the breach predicate so it composes with one.
F0/U5: open request 002 (urgent priority) would take the normal SLA target by URS-F-03.2.
FX: existing ticket endpoints violate URS-N-02 (three planted 500s); the sweep must drive them to JSON errors.
